lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Booker Schwartz is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Booker is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d41: Stonebridge watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.
d41: 🕯️ Booker Schwartz is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Booker kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Booker's gone." Maya looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Booker." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Ashley blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Herbal Medicine (Level 1). Willow bark = aspirin. Yarrow stops bleeding. Plantain draws out infection. The pharmacy is outside.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading the Land (Level 1). Eat the landscape with your eyes first: green + water + sun means food grows here. Start where those three meet.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: The Forager’s Eye (Level 1). You walk slower and see more. Food was always there; now you notice it.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Booker Schwartz, 41 days. The mantle passes to Ashley Rao.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Ashley Rao, 30 — a florist. Her hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Dowsing, Green Thumb, Literally, War Cry.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Booker — and Booker is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Rachel, Maya, Igor and 3 more speak for Ashley — "Booker trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Ashley before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.

d80: 📖 LEARNED: Diplomatic Incident (Level 1). Trust builds 2x faster. You're TOO good though — once per week you can start a diplomatic incident: villagers argue, you pick the winner (+trust with them, -trust with the loser).
d80: 📖 LEARNED: Keeping Morale (Level 1). People need small wins. Celebrate the little things. Despair is the real killer.
d80: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d80: 📖 LEARNED: Reading People (Level 1). Microexpressions leak truth. Watch the eyes, not the mouth. People tell you who they are.
d80: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Deep Read! You don't just read trust — you read intent. Know what they'll do next. (Your knowledge of Reading People amplifies your open_book.)

d80: You knew Ashley — not the office, the person. The fire keeps expecting her, and so do you. That's a heavier kind of stepping up. (+5 trauma)
